reconstruction_summary: Re-implemented V1 (the agent's stated favourite: per-segment IMU yaw-gyro bias) — bias = mean(yaw_meas - yaw_pred_v0) over straight samples (|delta|<0.01) per segment, added to V0 prediction.
notes: V1 = V0 + per-segment scalar bias estimated on |delta_road|<0.01 straight samples (bias=0 if <=20 such samples). Bias estimator uses entire segment for straight samples (no v_mps filter), matching the agent's script exactly. baseline_rmse_recomputed matches canonical V0 within 1e-6.
